```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *' # 09:00 Beijing time (UTC+8)

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  discussions: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  coffee_bot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Build coffee bot
        run: ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests

      - name: Run coffee bot
        env:
          MCP_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MCP_BOT_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          chmod +x ./scripts/post_coffee_lottery.sh
          ./scripts/post_coffee_lottery.sh
```
